final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts` and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts` as the README describes, and all 3 tests pass.

The three functions share one parsing path, so they throw the same errors on malformed lists. The tests only cover merging, counting and one out-of-range port, so I didn't test the other error cases or empty and whitespace-only lists separately.
